_doc: The main line (UI spec §3.4; build item N-1.5): one gold step under the vitals naming the next main-story action, in the camp's voice. The first step whose when (a story condition) holds is shown; none shows nothing. Hidden in fights. Written by the story threads as the story grows; these cover the first playable.

steps.text: Someone carried you out of the Orrery. Ask around the camp who it was.
Go down the north stair and find a way through the College halls to the Kiln.
Go on past the Kiln hall, deeper into the College.
